findings.claim: No test ever calls `create_run` with a real (non-None) `batch_id` and checks that the stored value round-trips. `test_a_run_created_outside_a_batch_has_a_null_batch_id` only exercises the default-None path, so hard-coding the insert to always write NULL regardless of the `batch_id` argument (e.g. replacing the tuple `(repo_id, base_sha, batch_id)` with `(repo_id, base_sha, None)`) keeps every test in this diff green. The gap is deliberate for now since SA-0049 is the first caller that passes a real value, but the parameter and its wiring land in this diff with no witness that the non-null path actually works.
